Retitled

Josephine Keegan includes a version of this tune as Reel #13 in her 2004 tunebook “A Drop in the Ocean”. However, as often for settings in her book, she gives it a new title — in this case The Cavan Reel.

↳ Posted by rwwt on March 24th, 2015.

Re: The Doon

A version was collected as ‘A Galway Reel’ from Stephen Ruane, piper, Galway, at the Feis Ceóil sometime between 1897 and 1913. It is number 30 in the Darley and McCall collection (from where I got this info.)

↳ Posted by jamesa on May 8th, 2022.

The Doon, X:6

This is another Sliabh Luachra setting based on Johnny O’Leary’s playing, recorded and transcribed by Pat Slattery in the mid 70s in Knocknagree. Pat was given an excellent name for it: “Mists of Sliabh Luachra”. However there is a similar reel with that name, and I’m not sure it is ever used for this Doon Reel.
Not surprisingly this version is similar to JamesA’s posting from POK’s playing, but developed to give 16 bars to each part. There’s another POK version from the ITMA collection, which again is close to X:5 -
https://www.itma.ie/digital-library/score/padraig_okeeffe_oconnell_ms_108 ITMA has titles Cronin’s Reel / O’Keeffe’s Favourite, but it is not clear if these were on the original manuscript.

↳ Posted by brailsford on May 17th, 2022.
